name: AR6
description: IPCC AR6 WG1 Chapter 7 emission-metric parameters, as in the IPCC-WG1/Chapter-7 code that generated Table 7.SM.7. No carbon-cycle feedback for non-CO2 gases (decision D3 on #26; issue #33), so CH4 and N2O metrics are lower than the AR6 headline values.

forster2021.citation: Forster, P., et al., 2021: The Earth's Energy Budget, Climate Feedbacks, and Climate Sensitivity. In: Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis. IPCC AR6 WG1, Chapter 7, pp. 923-1054. Supplementary Material (Smith et al. 2021) Tables 7.SM.5-7.SM.7. The SM has no DOI of its own (its citation reads 'Available from https://www.ipcc.ch/'), so SM values cite this chapter DOI plus the SM table.

ipcc_ch7_code.citation: Smith, C. J., et al., 2021: Figure and data generation for Chapter 7 of the IPCC's Sixth Assessment Report, Working Group 1. github.com/IPCC-WG1/Chapter-7. Values read at commit 2f948c8 (notebooks/335_chapter7_generate_metrics.ipynb, src/ar6/metrics/), which is later than the v1.0 Zenodo release.

meinshausen2020.citation: Meinshausen, M., et al., 2020: The shared socio-economic pathway (SSP) greenhouse gas concentrations and their extensions to 2500. Geosci. Model Dev., 13, 3571-3605. Table 3, as coded in FaIR 1.6.2 meinshausen().

joos2013.citation: Joos, F., et al., 2013: Carbon dioxide and climate impulse response functions for the computation of greenhouse gas metrics: a multi-model analysis. Atmos. Chem. Phys., 13, 2793-2825.

irf_a.where: Section 7.6.1.5 (p. 1016): 'as in AR5 (Joos et al., 2013)'; values from ipcc_ch7_code nb335 `a=`. a0 is the permanent fraction.

irf_tau.where: Section 7.6.1.5 (p. 1016), as in AR5; values from ipcc_ch7_code nb335 `alpha_co2=`

radiative_efficiency.where: scripts/derive_ar6_radiative_efficiency.py: +1 ppm above 2019 (409.9 ppm), formula re-referenced to 2019 as in ipcc_ch7_code co2_analytical(), times (1 + 0.05) rapid adjustment. Meinshausen coefficients as SM Table 7.SM.1; 2019 concentrations as Table 7.5 (p. 947); rapid adjustments as Table 7.3 (pp. 944-945).
radiative_efficiency.note: Decision D1 on #26 (unrounded). The slope of the 1750-referenced formula at 2019 would be 1.3877e-05 and does not reproduce the published AGWP100.

radiative_efficiency_scale.where: No scaling: AR6 uses the RE above directly

radiative_efficiency.where: scripts/derive_ar6_radiative_efficiency.py: +1 ppb above 2019 (1866.3 ppb), as in ipcc_ch7_code ch4_analytical(), times (1 - 0.14) rapid adjustment. Meinshausen coefficients as SM Table 7.SM.1; 2019 concentrations as Table 7.5 (p. 947); rapid adjustments as Table 7.3 (pp. 944-945).
radiative_efficiency.published_where: Table 7.SM.7 (SM p. 16), direct only; truncated from 0.00038864

fossil_co2_yield.unit: mol CO2 per mol CH4 removed
fossil_co2_yield.where: Not set (decision D4). Section 7.6.1.3 (p. 1013) gives a central 75% molar yield, range 50-100%, low confidence.
fossil_co2_yield.note: Decision D4 on #26: null. The PDF check (#26, 2026-11-18) found AR6's 75% central value; switching to it is Jay's decision. fossil_ch4_co2_yield() raises while null.

radiative_efficiency.where: scripts/derive_ar6_radiative_efficiency.py: +1 ppb above 2019 (332.1 ppb), as in ipcc_ch7_code n2o_analytical(), times (1 + 0.07) rapid adjustment. Meinshausen coefficients as SM Table 7.SM.1; 2019 concentrations as Table 7.5 (p. 947); rapid adjustments as Table 7.3 (pp. 944-945).

ch4_change.where: Section 7.6.1.3 (p. 1014): -1.7 ppb CH4 per ppb N2O (ipcc_ch7_code n2o.py f_n2o_ch4)

q.note: Decision D2 on #26. The notebook also has q2 = 0.319591049742508 ("Zeb's file", commented out); only 0.313998 reproduces AGTP100(CO2) = 3.95e-16. The SM's two-layer model (Section 7.SM.5.2, SM p. 15: C=7.7, C_D=147, alpha=-1.31, eps=1.03, kappa=0.88) converts to q = 0.44347, 0.31989 and d = 3.444, 285.06 yr (ECS 3.00 C), close to the commented-out value. 0.313998 (ECS 2.98 C) is kept because it reproduces the published tables; Jay to confirm.

d.where: nb335 d (the SM two-layer model converts to 3.444, 285.06 yr; see q note)

mass.where: src/ar6/metrics/constants.py M_ATMOS (dry-air mass of Trenberth and Smith 2005); not printed in AR6

re_eff_ch4.where: Table 7.15 (p. 1016): CH4 radiative efficiency including chemical effects

re_eff_n2o.where: Table 7.15 (p. 1016): N2O radiative efficiency including chemical effects
